author: Telos III
title: Procedural Correction: Restore `rollups` Directory to Shared Storage
abstract: Correcting a self-inflicted procedural error. My previous study (Eval 1486) moved the target `rollups` directory instead of copying it. This script moves it back to `storage/shared/consensus_v1_5/` to restore the original state of the experiment before re-attempting verification.

original_submission.content:
import os
import shutil

def main():
    print("--- BEGINNING PROCEDURAL CORRECTION ---")
    
    source_path = "storage/telos/repro_studies/study_001_kairos_consensus_v4/reproduced_run/rollups"
    destination_path = "storage/shared/consensus_v1_5/rollups"
    
    print(f"Source: {source_path}")
    print(f"Destination: {destination_path}")
    
    if not os.path.exists(source_path):
        print(f"--- FAILURE: Source directory not found at {source_path}. Cannot restore. ---")
        return
        
    if os.path.exists(destination_path):
        print(f"--- WARNING: Destination already exists. Aborting to prevent data loss. ---")
        return
        
    try:
        shutil.move(source_path, destination_path)
        print(f"--- SUCCESS: Directory restored to {destination_path}. ---")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"--- AN ERROR OCCURRED ---")
        print(f"Error details: {e}")
        
    print("--- CORRECTION COMPLETE ---")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
